Anya R: quick sync  product wants a tiny 'notify rationale' on SLO cards showing why a page did/didn't fire. what's minimal API?
Ben T: server-side single endpoint seems best: GET /v1/tenants/:id/notify-rationale returning flat fields: sensitivity_label, computed_threshold, last_action_reason, cost_snapshot. front-end just renders.
Liam H: +1. also include explain_chain as a short, human-readable list (cap 3 items). keep items as strings to avoid nested parsing.
Anya R: override UX: product wants a "Snooze alerts" button that POSTs /v1/tenants/:id/overrides with TTL. need guardrails.
Ben T: guardrails: non-admin <= 6h, admin <= 7d; server validates TTL and emits an immutable audit event. rate-limit writes per tenant.
Liam H: runtime will emit compact notify-eval telemetry with chosen_rule and exposure_pct; API should include last_applied_reason so console can show "auto-snooze: quota-backpressure".
ops-bot: synthetic-check: notify-eval emitted for sandbox-3 at 4123456795 (no page) :white_check_mark:
Anya R: QA plan: canary that synthesizes a breach, verify explain_chain contains fallback reason, and cost_snapshot within 5% of billing snapshot. also strip emails/PII from payloads.
Ben T: final API debate: server returns canonical computed blob or console rehydrates? server-only to avoid drift. easier rollback.
